denominator_definition: All original query material points at common exported physical times with GT visibility in at least two cameras whose captured time intervals contain the query time; independent of estimated validity, confidence and method selection

support.duration_definition: Sum of adjacent valid sample intervals; gaps are excluded

config.motion_prior_units: Sum per trajectory of integral squared world acceleration dt; lambda not secretly normalized by image or point count

derivatives.predicted_derivative: Finite differences of exported positions; includes sampling truncation error
derivatives.ground_truth_derivative: Continuous analytic material motion, symmetric difference at 0.1ms

interpretation: Synthetic world errors are raw metres without rigid/similarity alignment. Reprojection reduction alone is not independent 3D accuracy. Real published sync values are reference comparisons, not certified GT.

shared_holdout_comparison.interpretation: Primary methods share exactly the same original held-out 2D measurements. All-method comparison fixes B0 observed_uv and holdout mask, intersects finite predictions and every method time window. B4 may use different tracked coordinates internally; this fixed raw measurement reference is not independent GT.
